name: Utah honeysuckle
desc: Utah honeysuckle (Lonicera utahensis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lonicera utahensis is a species of flowering plant in the honeysuckle family known by the common names Utah honeysuckle, red twinberry, and fly honeysuckle. It is native to western North America.
